description:
Matches the user's own words for the work they want against FoundRole's role list and returns up to
5 roles with open jobs, each with its number of open jobs in the place's state or
country, most jobs first, plus the role already saved on the account. It runs no job search and changes
nothing on the account. jobs_search returns the jobs for a role.

location.description: Place to count open jobs in (e.g., 'Austin, TX'); the account's place when omitted

words.description: The user's own words for the work they want, such as "analyst" or "nurse in a clinic"

name: roles_lookup
title: Look up roles
